_comment: Tier-2 for Kratos dem#3: DEM is always 3D internally — MDPA must use SphericParticle3D even for 2D problems. There is no SphericParticle2D registered. ModelPart.CreateNewElement('SphericParticle2D', ...) raises RuntimeError 'Element "SphericParticle2D" is not registered!'. Verified empirically 2026-06-01. INDEX SHIFTED by the guidance reclassification; the claim this fixture verifies is unchanged and every #index quoted above is the current one. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 creates the registered SphericParticle3D instead of the unregistered SphericParticle2D, so the element is created. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: RuntimeError, is not registered. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dem_spheric_particle_2d_rejected && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
_key_correction: Was keyed dem::1. dem::1 is '[Input] DEM builds four mdpa filenames by concatenating problem_name with fixed tags', which this fixture does not test. It creates elements, and the only thing it establishes is that SphericParticle2D is not registered -- the first half of dem::13. Re-keyed 2026-08-07. NOTE: dem::13 is also covered, more completely, by dem_has_real_2d_cylinder_particles, which pins BOTH halves (the unregistered SphericParticle2D and the registered CylinderParticle2D / CylinderContinuumParticle2D). This fixture is therefore redundant rather than load-bearing, and the coverage report will show dem::13 double-counted. It is kept, not deleted, because it still executes and still fails if Kratos ever registers SphericParticle2D.
